description: This file defines two asynchronous functions, getOAuthApiKey and refreshOpenAICodexToken, that wrap imported OAuth token functions with additional environment setup.

methods.name: export async function getOAuthApiKey( getOAuthApiKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an OAuth API key, ensuring the global environment proxy is set up before calling the imported function.

methods.name: export async function refreshOpenAICodexToken( refreshOpenAICodexToken
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the OpenAI Codex token, ensuring global environment setup prior to invoking the imported refresh function.
